list.title: Knowledge Base
list.noArticlesInFolder: No articles in this folder yet.
list.emptyDescription: Capture what your team knows — runbooks, how-tos, onboarding notes. Write your first article or import one from a file.
list.linkedTooltip: {count, plural, one {Linked to # item} other {Linked to # items}}
list.draftTooltip: Only you can see it until it's published

search.degradedNote: Full-text search is unavailable right now — showing title and excerpt matches instead.

quickSwitcher.title: Search articles
quickSwitcher.description: Jump to an article by title or content.
quickSwitcher.heading: Articles
quickSwitcher.startTyping: Type to search articles by title or content…
quickSwitcher.unavailable: Search is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.

form.newSubtitle: Write a draft in Markdown — publish it from the article once it's ready.
form.editSubtitle: Changes don't alter the published/draft state — use Publish on the article for that.
form.titlePlaceholder: How to set up the office VPN
form.categoryHint: No categories yet — use the + button to create one.
form.excerptPlaceholder: A one-line summary shown in listings (optional)
form.notSignedInDescription: You must be signed in to edit articles.

toast.signInRequired: You must be signed in to author articles
toast.slugTaken: A note with that name already exists — try a different title.

draft.restoreDescription: We saved a local draft from {time}. Restore it to keep editing, or discard it.

leaveConfirm.title: Discard unsaved changes?
leaveConfirm.description: You have unsaved changes. If you leave now, they won't be saved.

mdImport.hint: Drag a .md, .markdown or .txt file here to fill the content
mdImport.uploadOnly: Importing a Word document (.docx) or a .zip? Use Import from the Knowledge Base.

toast.tooLarge: That file is too large — the limit is 1 MB

replaceConfirm.title: Replace the current content?
replaceConfirm.description: The editor already has content. Importing this file replaces all of it — this can't be undone.

detail.notFoundDescription: It may be a draft you can't see, it was deleted, or the API is unreachable.
detail.deleteExtra: Published articles are visible to the whole team until then.

links.empty: Not linked to anything yet. Link this article to an asset or application to surface it as that record's runbook.
links.dialogDescription: Link this article to an asset or an application so it shows as that record's runbook. A link points to exactly one target.
links.duplicateHint: Already-linked targets are accepted by the API only once; a duplicate link is rejected.

import.title: Import an article
import.description: Upload a Markdown, plain-text, Word (.docx) or ZIP (.zip) file. Only the text is imported — the original file is not stored.
import.fileHint: Word documents (.docx), Markdown (.md, .markdown), plain text (.txt), or a .zip of Markdown for bulk import.
import.processingHint: Importing your file. Larger files and ZIP archives can take a moment.

toast.signInRequired: You must be signed in to import articles
toast.batchImported: {count, plural, one {# article imported} other {# articles imported}}

batch.title: Import complete
batch.summary: {created, plural, one {# article created} other {# articles created}}{renamed, plural, =0 {} one {, # renamed} other {, # renamed}}{skipped, plural, =0 {} one {, # skipped} other {, # skipped}}
batch.foldersCreated: {count, plural, one {# folder created} other {# folders created}}
batch.linksResolved: {count, plural, one {# wiki-link resolved} other {# wiki-links resolved}}
batch.renamedNote: Slug already taken — auto-suffixed to avoid a conflict.

form.createRootDescription: A top-level folder in the Knowledge Base.
form.createDescription: It is created inside the folder you picked. Folders can be nested as deeply as you like.
form.editDescription: Changing the name or description does not move the folder or change who can read it.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: What lives in this folder, in a sentence
form.orderHint: Optional. Lower numbers sort first; folders without one sort after, by name.
form.cannotClear: This can be changed but not removed yet — the current value is kept.

move.title: Move folder
move.description: Choose where {name} should live. Its sub-folders and its articles move with it.

errors.cycle: A folder can't be moved into itself or into one of its own sub-folders.
errors.deadParent: That folder no longer exists — someone may have deleted it. Reload the page and try again.
errors.duplicateName: A folder with this name already exists here. Pick a different name.
errors.duplicateInDestination: The destination already has a folder with this name. Rename one of them first.

delete.title: Delete this folder?
delete.warning: {name} and everything inside it will be removed from the Knowledge Base.
delete.subfolderWarning: This also deletes {count, plural, one {# sub-folder} other {# sub-folders}} and all of their articles.
delete.irreversibleNote: Articles in these folders are removed from the KB. This can only be undone by an administrator restoring them in the database.

toast.deleted: Deleted {folders, plural, one {# folder} other {# folders}} and {articles, plural, one {# article} other {# articles}}

references.empty: No other articles reference this one yet. Mention it as a [[slug]] wiki-link from another article to surface it here.

aliases.empty: This article only lives in its home folder. Add it to another folder to surface it there too — an alias never changes its home or who can see it.
aliases.dialogDescription: Place this article in another folder so it also shows up there when browsing. An alias is navigation only — it doesn't move the article's home or change who can see it.

versions.panelDescription: Every edit is captured as a numbered snapshot. Open the history to see who changed what and when.
versions.sheetDescription: Snapshots are newest-first. Click a version to read its full content.
versions.restoreConfirmDescription: This re-applies that version's title, body and excerpt as a new version. The earlier history is kept and the article's published status is unchanged.

access.publicHint: Visible to all authenticated team members.
access.inheritedRestrictedHint: This folder is restricted because it inherits a restriction from {name}. Add a rule below to narrow access further.
access.restrictedTooltip: Restricted — only specific users may read this folder

widens.title: Make this article readable by everyone?
widens.description: “{name}” is leaving a restricted folder for {destination}, which nothing restricts. Everyone who can read the knowledge base will be able to read this article.

changes.title: Change who can read this article?
changes.description: “{name}” is moving to {destination}, which is restricted by different access rules. The article will follow that folder's rules instead, and this may let more people read it.

widens.title: Make this folder's articles readable by everyone?
widens.description: “{name}” is leaving a restricted parent for {destination}, where nothing restricts it. Everyone who can read the knowledge base will be able to read its articles. Sub-folders with access rules of their own stay restricted by those rules.

changes.title: Change who can read this folder's articles?
changes.description: “{name}” is moving to {destination}, which inherits different access rules. The articles in it and in its sub-folders will follow the new location's rules, and this may let more people read them.

stats.drafts: {count, plural, one {<n>#</n> draft by you} other {<n>#</n> drafts by you}}

folderView.missingSubtitle: It may have been deleted, or you may not have access to it.

drafts.title: My drafts
drafts.subtitle: Only you can see your drafts until you publish them.

linked.title: Linked to assets and apps
linked.subtitle: Articles connected to at least one asset or application.

recent.title: Recent
recent.subtitle: Articles you opened in this browser, newest first. Kept only on this device.
recent.empty: Nothing yet. Articles you open appear here.
